borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: London Plane T1.1) Reduce tree to previous reduction points (approximately 4m-5m reduction in height and approximately 3m in radial spread). Tree to be approximately 17m in height upon completion. Remove epicormic growth on main stem. Tree subject to regular reduction pruning due to proximity to property.2) Prune single adventitious root to north west associated with direct damage to lower ground floor retaining wall necessary to allow repair works to be carried out (report sent to Tree Officer, Eugene Mcgee). Root pruning to be carried out under arboricultural supervision following further excavation and repair (40mm diameter where currently exposed, approximately 1m from point of anticipated root pruning). Minor root pruning <25mm diameter as necessary (in accordance with BS5837: 2012) if identified at time of works.Tree pruning work to be carried out prior to any root pruning / repairs.
